name: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd
about: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL), a 71.64% Government-owned Maha-Ratna CPSE, designs, manufactures, upgrades and provides lifecycle MRO for aircraft, helicopters, aero -engines, avionics /accessories and aerostructures, principally for India’s armed forces.

items.quote: In total, we expect to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including the ROH orders, during the next 2 years.

Sir, secondly, on margins, so your guidance of 30%, 31% margins, sir, with manufacturing share increasing and with some supply chain disru ptions that you highlighted, input costs going up, so how do you plan to deliver similar mar gins, sir, 30%, 31%?
The EBITDA margin we will be maintaining, s ee our EBITDA margin is around 38%-39%, and if you remove the interest income, so EBITD A will be around 31%.

bull.text: Profit grew faster than sales (23% vs 7.8% a year), so margins widened
Profits turn into cash: operating cash flow was 130% of PAT over 3 years

bear.text: EBITDA margin down 2.5 pts in two years to 29.6%
Working capital days stretched from 37 to 301

claims.summary: The prepared remarks on the latest calls had no whole-company figures to check; management spoke in segment numbers.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 131% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 45 days to pay, against 64 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 32% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. A large part of profit does not come from the core business.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 9% while operating profit grew 2%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 25%, against 25% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.00× equity, against 0.00× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 71.6%, unchanged over the last 4 reported quarters.
